The One Naiharn

Condominium in Nai Harn / Rawai
HomeSaleThe One Naiharn

Marketing images from the developer website, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A single eight-storey building with 196 apartments on a site of about 4,480 sqm, recorded as completed in March 2026. Listed in Rawai, it is marketed under the Nai Harn name and is about 1.7 km from Rawai Beach.

Resale and developer units come as studios of around 27 sqm, one-bedroom apartments from about 30 to 69 sqm and a small number of two-bedroom units. Facilities include a communal pool, kids pool and kids club, sauna, gym, indoor kids zone, lobby and automated parking, with hotel-style management.

Unit counts vary between portals (196 to 218), so confirm availability with the seller. Foreign buyers can hold freehold within the quota; the project pays a freehold premium per the portal.

The One Naiharn: key facts

  • The One Naiharn is a hotel-managed condominium in Nai Harn, Phuket, developed by The One Phuket Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 26.8–69 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Mar 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,700,000.
  • Nearest beach: Rawai Beach (1.7 km / 4 minutes, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Chalong Hospital (5.8 km, straight line); Dibuk Hospital (11.4 km, straight line); Makro (2.8 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (7.0 km, straight line).
